falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The May-2022 Luna-bottom analog would be confirmed as a tradable low, so UNKNOWN/HOLD would be wrong — the correct call would have been risk-on long, not flat.

falsification_conditions.condition: BTC prints a new 90-day closing low and finishes the window at least 20% below today's close, while VIX closes above 30 on at least 3 sessions in the same window.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The 78% bottom_2022_may_luna match would be invalidated by a fresh risk-off leg, so UNKNOWN/HOLD would be wrong — the correct call would have been defensive/short risk, not flat.

falsification_conditions.condition: US high-yield OAS moves at least 100 basis points from today's level (either tighter or wider) and the 10-year Treasury yield moves at least 40 basis points in the same direction as that spread move, both measured on closes within 14 days.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Credit and rates would have resolved the regime in one direction, so phase could no longer be Unknown and a directional signal would be required — HOLD would be falsified.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
